description: End-to-end smoke executed from the runnable worker images themselves: fixture generated in the validator image, validator image produced the handoff, finetuner image trained/published/reloaded from its baked-in weights. Both stages ran with --network none; the finetuner ran with --gpus all. Procedure: C:\swin-executor\rebuild-2026-09-11\{build_images.sh,image_smoke.sh} (Executor host nvidia-container-swin, a clone of the nvidia-container-base golden WSL image).

finetuner.weightStaging: downloaded at pinned HF revisions during image build and SHA-256 verified against the catalog (scripts/stage_weights.py); a mismatch fails the build; no Hub cache left in the image

environment.runtimeVersions: pillow 12.3.0 | safetensors 0.8.0 | timm 1.0.28 | huggingface_hub 1.29.0 | torch 2.8.0+cu128 | torchvision 0.23.0+cu128
environment.device: cuda:0 (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU, 610.88, sm_120)
environment.host: WSL2 distro nvidia-container-swin, Docker 29.7.2 with the containerd image store, NVIDIA Container Toolkit 1.20.0

inputImageForms.conversion: all non-RGB modes converted to RGB by load_visual_image (alpha dropped, grayscale replicated, palette expanded)
inputImageForms.resize: every image resized to 256x256 without preserving aspect ratio

limitations: Bounded 8-image fixture smoke from the worker images; not production-scale.
Image digests are the local containerd manifest digests; they become registry digests unchanged on push.
Training remains REEXECUTABLE: cross-entropy is not bitwise reproducible across runs.
